text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT ic-1999 - embeddings route (/v1/embeddings) in prod-west seeing sustained 3x QPS and error rate jump to ~5%. Autoscaler not keeping up. Paging @maya (oncall).
maya: ACK — pulling metrics and shard heatmap now. ETA 2m.
jordan: onstandby if you need a handoff.
maya: quick impact summary: high-fanout customers + many small embed calls. Errors are 5xx from runtime OOMs and 429s from rate limiter bursts. Non-enterprise tenants hit first.
maya: mitigation idea set (short): 1) temporary per-endpoint quota reduction for embeddings (non-enterprise) 2) carve hot routes to a lower-cost region pool 3) disable rerank and any CPU-heavy pre/post-processing for affected routes 4) enable smaller embed model fallback for low-priority traffic
ops-sre: please confirm any config endpoints/commands you want me to run.
maya: running changes now. Command to set non-enterprise per-endpoint cap:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/quotas/set \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","selector":"tier:non-enterprise","qps":0.5}'
```
maya: also issuing route carve to shift 30% of mid-tier traffic to eu-central pool:
```
POST https://control-plane.internal/api/routes/carve
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","percent":30,"target":"eu-central-pool"}
```
oncall-bot: Action log: quota change applied for selector tier:non-enterprise -> qps 0.5 (req id a1b2). Route carve job queued (job id carve-1999-1).
support-rot: Noted customer impact: ~14 customers saw transient errors, 2 enterprise accounts reported degraded throughput. CS notified; drafting status message.
ops-sre: metrics after actions: inbound QPS down ~28% to embeddings; error rate down to 1.2%; latencies improved slightly. Autoscaler catching up.
maya: disabling rerank for non-enterprise via feature-flag:
```
PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/featureflags/disable
{"flag":"rerank_nonenterprise","value":true}
```
jordan: taking over if you need to dig deeper — can run heap dumps and investigate the OOM pattern. ETA 15m to be fully in.
maya: handing off to @jordan for post-mitigation and postmortem. Handoff notes: quota reduced, route carve 30% -> eu-central, rerank disabled for non-enterprise, fallback to mini-embed enabled for low-priority requests, monitoring rule lowered to 1.5% error alert threshold. Revert conditions: sustained error <0.5% for 15m and QPS back to baseline for 30m.
jordan: ack. I'll keep rollback plan ready: revert quotas incrementally (0.6 -> 0.8 -> 1.0) and re-enable rerank only after perf validates in canary.
sre-lead: good play. Recommend keeping the quota change for 30 minutes and monitor token cost/latency. Follow-up: schedule a quick RCA sync and push a short-term engineering ticket to look at autoscaler lag with high-fanout embed bursts.
support-rot: status page update posted (minor performance degradation affecting embeds). Will update customers we have a fallback and are throttling non-critical embed flows.
oncall-bot: Incident ic-1999 mitigation actions completed and ownership transferred to jordan for RCA. Marking incident as "mitigated - monitoring". Logs: a1b2, carve-1999-1, ff-1999.
__notes: generated for dataset: live traffic mitigations; per-endpoint quota tweaks (chat vs embeddings vs rerank)
